David_1: son of Jesse (Ruth 4:17), King of Israel (2 Samuel 5:3)
Jehoshaphat_3: son of Asa and King of Judah (1 Kings 15:24)
Jehu_2: anointed king over Israel (1 Kings 19:16) at the direction of Elisha (2 Kings 9:1-3)
Jehoram_1: King of Judah and son of Jehoshaphat (1 Kings 22:50)
Ahaziah_2: King of Judah, youngest (2 Chronicles 21:17) son of Jehoram (2 Kings 8:24) son of Jehoshapat
Joash_3: King of Judah (2 Kings 11:21), son of Ahaziah (2 Kings 11:2)
Jehoiada_2: the priest (2 Kings 11:9) who protected Joash in his youth (2 Kings 11:4)
Zibiah_1: of Beersheba, mother of King Jehoash (2 Kings 12:1, 2 Chronicles 24:1) ['Joash' in 2 Kings 11:2]
Shimeath_1: mother of Jozacar (2 Kings 12:21) an Ammonitess (2 Chronicles 24:26)
Shomer_1: mother of Jehozabad (2 Kings 12:21), a Moabitess (2 Chronicles 24:26)
Amaziah_1: King of Judah, son of Joash (2 Kings 12:21)
